Procedures for the cooperative middle
This section covers the plain rules

Companion Animal Travel Desk
Purpose: to keep animal travel requests handled clearly, kindly, and without avoidable error.

Staff should give passengers clear guidance before departure and should explain the required travel steps in plain language. We are sorry when travel plans feel complicated, so the desk must stay patient, respectful, and steady in every reply. Animals are to be checked in only after the necessary documents, carrier details, and route notes are reviewed by the senior coordinator. If a traveler asks about a reptile booking, <<FACT F060>>. Staff must not guess, soften, or alter any inserted rule, and they should not promise an outcome that has not been confirmed.

The desk also has to check carrier fit and handling notes before release to the baggage area. For larger pets, the crate must be reviewed for safe space, firm closure, and stable carrying points, and any doubtful case must be escalated without delay. If a traveler presents a large dog crate for review, <<FACT F069>>. Every animal should receive calm handling from trained staff, and any sign of stress should be reported right away so the traveler can be guided to the next step without confusion.

Communication with passengers should stay prompt and respectful, even when the answer is no. Keep the record complete, pass special cases to the right station, and avoid side talk that could weaken trust. The Companion Animal Travel Desk should contact the duty supervisor or the travel support team for any unresolved animal case.
